title: Chapter 325: Northern Theater Joint Base
content:
Chapter 325: Northern Theater Joint Base

On the desert battlefield, a rare war broke out, and the real world and the mezzanine world were almost completely connected.

The desert races living nearby were frightened by the terrible celestial phenomena in the battlefield area, and they all fled far away as soon as the sky brightened.

In the main city of the Naga tribe in the ancient desert territory, a large number of Naga people spent the whole night observing the celestial phenomena deep in the desert.

On a high point in the city, the Naga leaders were accompanying several powerful goblin tribe members.

"This is indeed a battle with the weird. I didn't expect that the Zerg has been fighting the weird here recently!"

"No wonder they can get the status of a big clan through special quotas in such a short time!"

"Attracting weird to fight in the real world is the result we see now. The more we fight, the more fragile the space becomes, and the more and stronger the weird gathered!"

"How many races can withstand such a big battle?"

"Fortunately, the space will be stable again at dawn. Otherwise, if we continue to fight like this, it will only be a matter of time to open a permanent space channel!"

"The Zerg is so powerful! I don't know where they come from!"

"There are too many mysterious races in this world. No matter what their origin is, as long as they are in our camp, the Zerg will kill the evil god camp and the weird, and they are more ruthless than anyone else!"

Huanyuanapp! .huanyuanapp

"Haha, that's right!"

"..."

The Goblins were a little confused about the Zerg's rapid acquisition of the status of a big clan. They only learned about the situation on the desert battlefield through the communication with the Naga tribe, and they came here to take a look.

This has confirmed that the Zerg had been fighting against the weird on a large scale before it gained the status of a great clan.

Only in this way can it be so favored by the world rules, and thus pass the extremely difficult assessment and gain the status of a great clan.

…

Just as the sky dawned, the world rules were stable, the fragile space returned to normal, and all the weirdness was excluded by the world rules.

A great war between the Zerg, the Protoss and the weirdness ended.

Wu Qing's consciousness has returned to the body, and he and the Zerg and the Archon are preparing for the Zerg to enter the Northern War Zone.

Through the intelligence that has been obtained, Wu Qing has a more comprehensive understanding of the Northern War Zone.

The Northern War Zone was originally considered a very powerful war zone in the local camp, and it was evenly matched with the evil god camp.

Since the evil god camp suddenly joined several powerful ice and snow races, the situation has taken a sharp turn for the worse.

After these years of brutal wars, several super clans of the local camp in the Northern War Zone have been defeated successively and lost their status as great clans, and there are countless clans that have lost their status as great clans.

After the races adapted to fighting in cold regions suffered a series of blows, the local camp no longer had any spare forces to show.

Other super tribes had to face powerful enemies. If they moved, the impact would be very large, and other war zones might fall one after another.

Moreover, the combat effectiveness of general super tribes and large tribes would be greatly affected in the environment of the northern war zone, and it would be useless to go to support them.

This made the army led by the super tribe of the evil god camp, the snow demon tribe, beat the local camp all the way back, and the entire cold area in the north was almost occupied by the evil god camp.

Out of the cold area, the combat effectiveness of the army in the northern war zone of the evil god camp would be greatly reduced. The local camp relied on this method to survive, and in fact the entire northern war zone was considered to have fallen.

In such a situation, the Zerg took on the task of leading the war in the northern war zone. No wonder all the super tribes and large tribes of the local races had no opinion on the Zerg.

In the eyes of some people, the Zerg, such a fool, is too likable.

Faced with such a northern battlefield, the Zerg almost had to start from scratch and reverse the situation with the power of one clan.

Wu Qing has received a special space coordinate sent by the local camp. Any space transmission channel can directly reach the northern theater through this special space coordinate.

Originally, everyone wanted the Zerg to borrow the space transmission channels of other races to relay the Zerg to the vicinity of the northern theater and get in touch with several large clans fighting in the northern theater.

Wu Qing felt that this method was too troublesome, so he asked for a space coordinate like the Naga clan opened up the desert battlefield.

This type of space coordinate is only located in the corresponding area. There is no corresponding space transmission channel on the opposite side. It is unknown where it will be transmitted to in the end.

Transmission through this type of space coordinate has certain risks.

However, Wu Qing wants such a space coordinate. The Zerg and the Protoss are not afraid of risks, and Wu Qing does not want to communicate with too many races for the time being. It is a waste of time.

When the Zerg recaptures the northern theater by itself, all problems will no longer be problems. There is no intrigue, simple and direct.

In the Zerg base camp, a special team is gathering.

A seven-star Protoss fleet, escorting a large number of transport Zerg hosts and Protoss transport planes, is preparing to go to the unknown land in the northern war zone through the Zerg pupa channel.

When the Zerg and Protoss armies are transported there, there may be a fight, so a certain escort force is needed, and the Protoss fleet composed of Protoss reconnaissance aircraft, Protoss pirate ships, Protoss motherships and Protoss arbitrators is the best escort force.

In particular, there are Protoss arbitrator spacecraft in the team, which can provide stealth blessing to the entire army.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

With the Protoss Berserker, Protoss Dragon Knight, Protoss High Templar, Protoss Dark Templar and Protoss Gold Beetle transported in the Protoss transport plane, a large-scale war can be fought with a small number of troops.

The Zerg is much simpler. In addition to an eight-star Zerg Queen following just in case, the transport Zerg host is loaded with Zerg worker bees to quickly build a Zerg base.

All combat arms of the Zerg can be directly hatched after the Zerg base is built, without the need to be transferred through teleportation, which is a waste of effort.

Wu Qing materialized a lot of high-level templars and dark templars this time. It won't be long before the Protoss will have powerful light archons and dark archons.

Not all Protoss can accept the transfer from ordinary Protoss to archons in the spiritual energy state, so Wu Qing doesn't force it, and everything goes with the flow.

At this time, whether or not to have these two arms has little impact on Wu Qing. The Zerg alone can fight all over the world. With the addition of a Protoss, Wu Qing will have more choices.

The Queen will input the spatial coordinates of the northern war zone into the high-star pupa channel of the Zerg base camp. Even the huge Protoss mothership can go to the northern war zone through this pupa channel.

A small Protoss probe spacecraft with anti-stealth energy and in stealth state was the first to be transmitted to the northern war zone through the Zerg pupa channel to explore the way.

Soon, Wu Qing saw the icy and snowy environment of the northern war zone through the picture transmitted by the Protoss intelligent brain archon.

The rules of this world are very incomplete. The places Wu Qing has been to can hardly see the distinction between the four seasons. The southern war zone where the Zerg are mainly active is almost always in a pleasant season.

Wu Qing saw ice and snow for the first time in this world.

Through the detection equipment of the Protoss probe spacecraft, it can be seen that the icy and snowy environment of this world is worse than all the icy and snowy environments Wu Qing has seen.

Wu Qing saw this environment and understood why ordinary races did not dare to send troops to aid the northern theater. Without the talent to adapt to the extreme cold weather, the army would suffer serious losses without fighting, and there was no way to fight.

Such an environment is not a problem for the Zerg and Protoss. They can adapt to the extreme cold environment of the universe, let alone the cold environment of a world.

The Protoss probe spacecraft with anti-stealth ability did not detect any major danger, and the entire northern theater pioneering force that Wu Qing sent behind was all teleported over.

Wu Qing possessed the Zerg host with consciousness and experienced the environment of the northern theater personally.

"I haven't felt this cool for a long time!"

Wu Qing felt that he was in a white and snowy world with a biting cold wind, which was a different experience.

The powerful energy in the bodies of the Zerg and Protoss arms can easily resist the cold here.

The Zerg relies entirely on physical adaptation, while all Protoss people, combat weapons, and spacecraft have energy shields, and the cold outside is ineffective against them.

All troops were transferred over, and the Protoss probe spacecraft had quickly probed the surrounding areas. The Queen and the Archon selected the location for the construction of the Zerg base based on the information obtained.

All the Zerg and Protoss troops in stealth mode quietly flew to the destination. A large number of Zerg worker bees came out of the loading space of the transport Zerg host, broke through the ice layer, and quickly dug underground.

A large number of Zerg worker bees began to evolve on the spot, raising their strength to a higher star level and increasing the construction speed of the Zerg base.

Several Protoss probe spacecraft flew silently to the surrounding areas and opened the map of this area for Wu Qing.

With the technological support of the Protoss, work like drawing maps has become very simple.

The Protoss unmanned probe spacecraft in stealth mode can fly quickly without attracting the attention of any creatures, collect information on a large scale, and draw maps.

The Zerg worker bees dug through the thick ice layer and finally dug out the hard frozen soil.

No matter how hard the frozen soil is, it can be easily dug like tofu in front of professional Zerg worker bees.

It is still the way the Zerg built the sub-bases, first digging down to a sufficient depth, and then opening up the underground space.

The first Zerg mother nest was built, the first batch of Zerg worker bees hatched, and more Zerg worker bees joined the excavation work. With the conversion of the excavated materials by the Zerg mother nest, the Zerg worker bees worked more efficiently.

When the underground space had enough space, the Zerg space transmission channel Pupa Channel was built, and countless Zerg worker bees were teleported here from the Zerg base camp and other sub-bases.

Wu Qing wanted to build a super base in the northern theater to support the Zerg's next action plan in the entire northern theater.

When the Zerg base expanded to a large enough size, the Zerg worker bees began to dig at the location selected by the Protoss Archon. They wanted to dig out a huge underground base space for the Protoss.

The Protoss had giant spaceships like the Protoss mothership, which required a very large space and needed to dig a large enough entry and exit channel.

The Protoss also had unmanned mining probes that undertook the task of collecting Protoss resources, and their capabilities were similar to those of the Zerg worker bees.

At this time, Protoss unmanned probes also joined the excavation of the Protoss base space, and soon excavated a huge underground space.

A Protoss unmanned probe moved to a central position, released a transmission coordinate, and then quickly moved away.

A Protoss main control base was teleported through the materialization method and appeared in the central position.

This is the second main control base of the Protoss. A large number of Protoss unmanned probes were teleported through the main control base and joined the construction of the joint base of the Zerg and Protoss.

When the joint base of the Zerg and Protoss was built to a sufficient scale, a large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions were hatched.

Even with the Protoss arms, the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions are still the main combat forces.

The poisonous ray scorpions, which originally had limited adaptability, can adapt to the extremely cold environment here because of the integration of Zerg protozoan genes.

At this time, the Protoss unmanned probe spacecraft has already explored the situation in the surrounding areas.

The Zerg and the Archons combined the intelligence provided by the local camp and roughly determined the location of the Zerg and Protoss joint base, deep in the hinterland of the evil god camp.

This just fits Wu Qing's wishes. In this position, there are enemies all around. Just fight as much as you want. As long as you fight all the way to the area where the native camp is located, the Zerg will officially enter the northern war zone.

All the conspiracy tracks and interest calculations are not worth mentioning in front of the absolute strength of the Zerg and the Protoss.

A large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions rushed out of the joint base and rushed to various areas based on the existing intelligence.

Wu Qing has enough understanding of the weirdness. The Zerg and Protoss armies no longer need to worry about the weirdness.

Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions are outside, and there are many ways to avoid the weirdness.

Being in the enemy's hinterland, a war may break out at any time. The main combat forces of the Zerg and the high-end forces of the Protoss with a minimum of seven stars need to be prepared as soon as possible.

The main combat forces of the Zerg are still mainly air forces with strong mobility and combat power, and the main forces are mainly a large number of cheap Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, supplemented by limited Protoss combat weapons.

Because the strength of the Protoss has reached seven stars, they cannot easily participate in the war. Wu Qing plans to abide by this unspoken rule for the time being and not let the Protoss troops participate in the camp war for the time being.

However, the various combat weapons of the Protoss, like the powerful mechanical creations and battlefield treasures of the Goblins and the Aliens, can be used at will.

In this way, the main combat arms of the Zerg and the Protoss can be determined.

The Zerg air force still has a standard detachment as a unit, with 20 detachments at first, and it can be supplemented at any time if it is not enough.

The Protoss army mainly assists the Zerg army in combat, and is mainly based on air warships. Protoss reconnaissance aircraft, Protoss pirate ships, Protoss motherships and Protoss arbitrators are all equipped.
